notes.title: Tetradecagon is for sale on Steam!
notes.notes: Thank you guys for making my dream a reality. Tetradecagon is finally for sale on Steam and I am super stoked to work with you guys and hear your feedback. I will continue to improve and fix Tetradecagon as time progresses. Thanks everyone <3!

notes.title: Tetradecagon is on Steam!
notes.notes:
Thank you to all of the people who have stuck with and followed this project - I couldn't have done it without you. Tetradecagon should be fully released within a few days. Please expect a few minor bugs, although I have done thorough play testing you just never know what may arise. 

Many thanks!
-hellkitty
